008package paint.fiji.tracks;
009
010import static paint.shared.constants.PaintStringConstants.*;
011
012import fiji.plugin.trackmate.FeatureModel;
013import fiji.plugin.trackmate.Model;
014import fiji.plugin.trackmate.TrackMate;
015import fiji.plugin.trackmate.TrackModel;
016import paint.shared.constants.PaintTiming;
017import paint.shared.objects.Track;
018import paint.shared.utils.PaintLogger;
019import tech.tablesaw.api.IntColumn;
020import tech.tablesaw.api.StringColumn;
021import tech.tablesaw.api.Table;
022
023import java.nio.file.Path;
024import java.util.ArrayList;
025import java.util.Collections;
026import java.util.List;
027import java.util.Set;
028
029import static paint.fiji.tracks.TrackAttributeCalculations.calculateTrackAttributes;
030import static paint.shared.io.MainIOInterface.trackListToTable;
031import static paint.shared.io.MainIOInterface.writeSpecificTracksFile;
032
033/**
034 * Provides functionality to export TrackMate tracks to a CSV file.
035 * <p>
036 * Combines native TrackMate features with custom PAINT-calculated attributes,
037 * producing a structured dataset suitable for downstream statistical analysis.
038 * </p>
039 */
040public final class TrackDataExporter {
041
042    private TrackDataExporter() {
043        // Utility class; prevent instantiation
044    }
045
046    /**
047     * Writes track information from a TrackMate analysis into a CSV file.
048     * <p>
049     * Includes both TrackMate-calculated and PAINT-derived metrics, such as
050     * total distance, diffusion coefficients, and confinement ratio.
051     * </p>
052     *
053     * @param trackmate          TrackMate instance containing the model and features
054     * @param experimentName     experiment name for metadata tagging
055     * @param recordingName      recording name associated with the tracks
056     * @param csvTracksFilePath  destination CSV file
057     * @param visibleOnly        if true, exports only visible tracks
058     * @return total number of spots across all exported tracks
059     */
060    public static int writeTracksCsv(final TrackMate trackmate,
061                                     final String    experimentName,
062                                     final String    recordingName,
063                                     final Path      csvTracksFilePath,
064                                     final boolean   visibleOnly) {
065
066        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
067        // Step 1 – Extract TrackMate components
068        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
069        final Model model               = trackmate.getModel();
070        final TrackModel trackModel     = model.getTrackModel();
071        final FeatureModel featureModel = model.getFeatureModel();
072
073        // Collect and sort track IDs for deterministic output order
074        final Set<Integer>  trackIDsSet = trackModel.trackIDs(visibleOnly);
075        final List<Integer> trackIDs    = new ArrayList<>(trackIDsSet);
076        Collections.sort(trackIDs);
077
078        final List<Track> tracks = new ArrayList<>();
079        int totalSpots = 0;
080
081        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
082        // Step 2 – Process each track
083        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
084        for (Integer trackId : trackIDs) {
085            TrackAttributes trackAttributes = calculateTrackAttributes(trackModel, trackId, PaintTiming.TIME_INTERVAL);
086
087            Track track = new Track();
088            track.setExperimentName(experimentName);
089            track.setRecordingName(recordingName);
090
091            // Native TrackMate features
092            track.setNumberOfSpots(     asInt(   featureModel.getTrackFeature(trackId, "NUMBER_SPOTS")));
093            track.setNumberOfGaps(      asInt(   featureModel.getTrackFeature(trackId, "NUMBER_GAPS")));
094            track.setLongestGap(        asInt(   featureModel.getTrackFeature(trackId, "LONGEST_GAP")));
095            track.setTrackDuration(     roundOr( featureModel.getTrackFeature(trackId, "TRACK_DURATION"),     3, -1));
096            track.setTrackXLocation(    roundOr( featureModel.getTrackFeature(trackId, "TRACK_X_LOCATION"),   2, -1));
097            track.setTrackYLocation(    roundOr( featureModel.getTrackFeature(trackId, "TRACK_Y_LOCATION"),   2, -1));
098            track.setTrackDisplacement( roundOr( featureModel.getTrackFeature(trackId, "TRACK_DISPLACEMENT"), 2, -1));
099            track.setTrackMaxSpeed(     roundOr( featureModel.getTrackFeature(trackId, "TRACK_MAX_SPEED"),    2, -1));
100            track.setTrackMedianSpeed(  roundOr( featureModel.getTrackFeature(trackId, "TRACK_MEDIAN_SPEED"), 2, -1));
101
102            // Custom PAINT-calculated attributes
103            track.setDiffusionCoefficient(    roundOr(trackAttributes.diffusionCoeff,    2, -1));
104            track.setDiffusionCoefficientExt( roundOr(trackAttributes.diffusionCoeffExt, 2, -1));
105            track.setTotalDistance(           roundOr(trackAttributes.totalDistance,     2, -1));
106            track.setConfinementRatio(        roundOr(trackAttributes.confinementRatio,  2, -1));
107            track.setSquareNumber(-1);
108            track.setLabelNumber(-1);
109
110            totalSpots += trackAttributes.numberOfSpotsInTracks;
111            tracks.add(track);
112        }
113
114        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
115        // Step 3 – Build and export table
116        // ---------------------------------------------------------------------
117        try {
118            Table tracksTable = trackListToTable(tracks);
119
120            tracksTable = tracksTable.sortOn(
121                    RECORDING_NAME,
122                    NUMBER_OF_SPOTS,
123                    NUMBER_OF_GAPS,
124                    LONGEST_GAP,
125                    TRACK_DURATION,
126                    TRACK_X_LOCATION,
127                    TRACK_Y_LOCATION,
128                    TRACK_DISPLACEMENT,
129                    TRACK_MAX_SPEED,
130                    TRACK_MEDIAN_SPEED,
131                    DIFFUSION_COEFFICIENT,
132                    DIFFUSION_COEFFICIENT_EXT,
133                    TOTAL_DISTANCE,
134                    CONFINEMENT_RATIO
135            );
136
137            // Replace Track Ids and generate unique keys
138            IntColumn    newIds       = IntColumn.create(TRACK_ID);
139            StringColumn newUniqueKey = StringColumn.create(UNIQUE_KEY);
140
141            for (int i = 0; i < tracksTable.rowCount(); i++) {
142                newIds.append(i);
143                newUniqueKey.append(recordingName + "-" + i);
144            }
145            tracksTable.replaceColumn(TRACK_ID, newIds);
146            tracksTable.replaceColumn(UNIQUE_KEY, newUniqueKey);
147
148            writeSpecificTracksFile(csvTracksFilePath, tracksTable);
149
150        } catch (Exception e) {
151            PaintLogger.error("Failed writing track CSV", e);
152        }
153
154        return totalSpots;
155    }
156
157    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
158    // Helper Methods
159    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
160
161    /**
162     * Rounds a double to the specified number of decimal places.
163     *
164     * @param v      input value (nullable)
165     * @param places number of decimal places
166     * @return rounded value, or {@code Double.NaN} if null
167     */
168    private static double roundTo(Double v, int places) {
169        if (v == null) {
170            return Double.NaN;
171        }
172        double scale = Math.pow(10, places);
173        return Math.round(v * scale) / scale;
174    }
175
176    /**
177     * Rounds a double or returns a fallback if {@code v} is null.
178     *
179     * @param v       input value (nullable)
180     * @param places  decimal precision
181     * @param ifNull  fallback value when input is null
182     * @return rounded value or fallback
183     */
184    @SuppressWarnings("SameParameterValue")
185    private static Double roundOr(Double v, int places, double ifNull) {
186        return v == null ? ifNull : roundTo(v, places);
187    }
188
189    /**
190     * Converts a Double to an int, returning -1 for null or NaN.
191     *
192     * @param v Double value
193     * @return integer value or -1 for invalid input
194     */
195    private static int asInt(Double v) {
196        if (v == null || v.isNaN()) {
197            return -1;
198        }
199        return (int) Math.round(v);
200    }
201}
